purpose: Boundary/choice correspondence summarized from one agent-visual-review example; no original Flora JSON, caption text, video or contact sheet is stored here

raw_label_aliases.L1: first near-side folding attempt with an overlong raw interval
raw_label_aliases.L5: far-side folding goal with an early raw start

alias_binding: Ln maps to source label tshirt-train-128691-w000:s0000n; the automatic planner assigns task-local Cxxx IDs, so regression resolves expected candidates through source_label_ids, not a cross-task Cxxx comparison
invariants: 10 atoms become9 primary intervals by merging the adjacent L7 choices
a real respreading/reset remains between folding attempts
near-edge alignment precedes the opposite-side fold; overlaps do not become concurrent native labels
the15-frame gap is resolved by evidence-backed neighbor choice, not previous-label carry-forward
no fixed folding order or stack-success label is introduced
the choice mapping is a regression reference for this example, not a semantic accuracy benchmark for319 episodes
